Modern PHP SDK for DataCite REST API using Saloon. Supports DOI registration, metadata management, and retrieval.

Use PHP 8.4+ syntax only
Add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file
Make all classes final unless inheritance is required
Use readonly properties wherever possible
Use constructor property promotion
Use typed properties and return types
Follow PSR-12 coding standards
Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code

Namespaces: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk`, `.Data`, `.Requests`, `.Enums`.
DTOs are `final readonly`; Requests are `final` and extend `Saloon\Http\Request`; Enums are backed enums with string or int values. Use traits from `Traits/`; member-only requests must use `RequiresMemberAuth`.
DataCite.php is the main client entry point. All responses use Data DTOs. Requests are organized by endpoint; Data contains response DTOs.

Use constructor property promotion for DTOs. Implement `HasPaginationParams`, `HasFieldParams`, `HasIdParams`. Follow Data/ naming conventions. Use typed arrays in DocBlocks: `<REDACTED_USER> DoiObject[]`.

Public API: read-only GET, no auth. Member API: POST/PUT/DELETE, full access. Add `RequiresMemberAuth` to requests that use POST, PUT, DELETE, member data, or modify DOI records.

Run before committing:
`composer test`
`composer lint`
`composer test:unit`
`composer test:types`
`composer refactor`

use VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Traits\Requests\RequiresMemberAuth;
CreateDOI: `final class CreateDOI extends Request`; `use RequiresMemberAuth;  // Enforces member auth requirement`; `protected Method $method = Method::POST;`
